{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''company''' controlled by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]]. The shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]] would regularly transfer [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the company, meant for the [[Thanda clan]] of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], whom Taug had helped finance a fleet of [[slaveship]]s which he was invested in. The company then appointed a courier to pick up the credits on Junction and transport them to a [[Shadowport/Legends|Shadowport]], where a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] courier, who was named [[Prit Kessek]] and was working for a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Unidentified Herglic crime syndicate|crime syndicate]], would pick them up an transport them to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. The courier and Shadowport used would change with each payment, as would the identity used by Kessek to collect it. One [[Unidentified Bagman|courier]] that the company used was a [[Human/Legends|Human]], who was instructed to deliver the credits to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Bazarre]], traveling there with a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Unidentified Houk bodyguard|bodyguard]] via [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]].<ref name="ZT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref>
{{RPG}}
The courier operation was put to an end when the Human courier was ambushed at [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Junction by a group of hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] trying to shut down the Thanda clan. The spacers then impersonated the guard to reach Kessek, and then subdued and impersonated her to reach [[Atlee Thanda]], a member of the clan whom they defeated.<ref name="ZT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The company first appeared in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released online by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]]. The adventure tasks players with taking down Atlee Thanda by impersonating the various couriers who transport credits to him which this article assumes they were successful in doing.
